request: GEOMETRY-REQ-0001 item 1 (validation at n = 9: exact count of affine solutions)

results.statement: the affine system at n = 9 has exactly 48 solutions over C, all reduced: E_1, E_2 and 46 others of rank 3, of which 28 are real (4 positive semidefinite, 24 with a negative eigenvalue) and 18 are not real

extension_to_n10.description: this ensemble is the n = 10 witness without its last atom; a solution of the n = 10 system is a solution of this one that also satisfies the two equations of the last atom
